newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cellstar upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cellstar upgraded to buy.

text.p: --Rauscher Pierce Refsnes analyst Harry Blount said he upgraded CellStar Corp to buy-market outperformer from market performer.
--Shares in the cellular telephone wholesaler were up 1-1/2 to 16.
--Blount said he also raised the company's 1996 fourth quarter earnings estimates to $0.21 per share from $0.06 per share.

--"Our increased level of optimism regarding fourth quarter is based on a rebound in the company's Asian business, anticipated improvements in cost controls, anticipated contributions from Pacific Bell PCS rollout and the savings from the sale of Communications Centers to MCI," Blount said.
